pages.title: The Ancient Lands
pages.text: The $(egyptian)Ancient Curse$() world features unique biomes inspired by ancient Egypt. Each offers different resources and challenges.$(br2)Use $(l)/locate biome ancientcurse:$() commands to find specific biomes.

pages.title: Available Biomes
pages.text: $(li)$(l)Ancient Desert$(): Standard desert$(li)$(l)Deshret Desert$(): Red sand dunes$(li)$(l)Nile River$(): Fertile riverbanks$(li)$(l)Nile Floodplains$(): Rich farmland$(li)$(l)Valley of Kings$(): Tomb region$(li)$(l)Oasis$(): Water sources
